title: "svelte/no-store-async"
description: "Disallow using async/await inside svelte stores because it causes issues with the auto-unsubscribing features"
# Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit below this line.

The function that `readable`, `writable` and `derived` of `svelte/store` call when the first subscriber comes may return a function that stops the store. An `async` function returns a promise instead, so the store is never stopped.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/no-store-async": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
<script>
  import { readable } from "svelte/store";

  const time = readable(0, async (set) => {
    set(await fetchTime());
  });
</script>
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
<script>
  import { readable } from "svelte/store";

  const time = readable(0, (set) => {
    fetchTime().then(set);
  });
</script>
```
